name: Salesforce Agentforce
summary: Salesforce's agent platform for CRM: autonomous agents, Einstein copilots, and AI embedded in Sales and Service Cloud.
description:
Salesforce Einstein brings AI-driven analytics, insights, and automation to the Salesforce CRM, empowering marketers with predictive, personalized, and automated capabilities.

AIforce lets you use trusted Salesforce data and agents in the tools you already work in — Slack, Claude, and beyond. See how it works.

Predictive analytics and opportunity scoring. Automated insights for sales and marketing. Personalization for emails and offers. AI-powered workflow automation.

pricing.label: Premium
pricing.note: Price label carried over from the previous catalog and not rechecked.

features: Automated insights for sales and marketing.

howToUse.title: Access Salesforce Einstein
howToUse.description: Log in to your Salesforce account. Make sure Einstein is enabled in your CRM environment.

howToUse.title: Configure Data Sources
howToUse.description: Connect CRM data, marketing platforms, and external data sources to feed Einstein’s analytics and prediction engine.

howToUse.title: Leverage Predictive Analytics
howToUse.description: Use Einstein’s predictive scoring to identify high-value leads and opportunities, and to automate smart follow-ups.

howToUse.title: Automate Campaigns & Workflows
howToUse.description: Set up automated campaigns and workflow rules using Einstein’s AI recommendations, triggers, and segmentation.

howToUse.title: Personalize at Scale
howToUse.description: Let Einstein personalize emails, offers, and content for each contact based on data-driven insights.

howToUse.title: Monitor and Refine
howToUse.description: Track performance with built-in analytics. Adjust automation and personalization strategies for continuous improvement.

statusNote: Formerly marketed as Salesforce Einstein; Agentforce is the current agent brand.
